comment: Interactive by design: the module's own summary instructs the tester to press cancel on the login screen. The scripted browser signs in, so the expected access_denied never happens. Run by hand when certifying.
Same module, second condition of the same manual interaction.
Follows from the same manual interaction: with no error returned, the check for extra parameters warns.

The module wants the first visit to the login screen left incomplete so the same request_uri can be presented a second time; the scripted browser completes every login it sees. Run by hand when certifying.

The unknown claim is `sid`, which OIDC Front/Back-Channel Logout defines and this provider mints so a logout can name the login. An extension claim, not a leak: the suite itself says the warning may indicate extensions in use.
